profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker DT. Its website describes it as an observability platform built for the age of AI, combining observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform. The company says its platform is intended to help organizations innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and drive better business outcomes, and it describes itself as the AI-powered observability leader.

The site presents the future of observability as preventive and autonomous, using what it calls deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. The site quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, on that point, and quotes a customer saying that Dynatrace's AI engine provides insights for early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time required to identify root causes from hours to minutes.

The company's record lists no lawsuits and no MCP servers, and no products are tracked for it. Its Massachusetts law exposure record shows a count of 191.
